message.content:
This black-and-white editorial illustration features a close-up portrait of an elderly man with glasses, a mustache, a goatee, and a peci hat. He faces slightly left, displaying a faint smile. His round-framed glasses sit prominently on his nose. A white rectangular box positioned near his ear contains the text "AGUS SALIM".

At the top, the large white word "TEMPO" dominates the background. Above it, "EDISI KHUSUS KEMERDEKAAN" is printed in smaller white letters. Below "TEMPO," the text "EDISI 12-18 AGUSTUS 2013" appears. The lower right features large white text: "DIPLOMAT", "JENAKA", "PENOPANG", and "REPUBLIK".

The upper-left corner displays a red circular logo with "68" inside, surrounded by stylized waving lines and text. The lower-left corner shows "RP 38.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with "00024" and "9 770126 427302". The spine on the far-left edge lists "EDISI KHUSUS KEMERDEKAAN", "TEMPO", and "AGUS SALIM" vertically. The man wears a light-colored, collared shirt. His facial features include detailed wrinkles around the eyes and on the forehead.
